: Hi Nao. It’s really nice to see you for the first time today.
: What are you doing over here by yourself? Is Kaori off building her time machine or whatever it is?
: She won a prize?
: Also, did you write that yourself?
: Since when do you know how to write?
: Okay. Well, I guess Kaori can work on teaching you listening comprehension whenever she gets back.
: I’ll keep you company for now, though. The last thing I want is some dangerous man finding you out here all alone and taking advantage of you while no one else is around to watch. I mean help.
: It’s nothing you need to be concerned about. Kaori says there might just be a me inside of me. And if there was a me inside of me then me would probably make me say things like that.
: Who even knows at this point? Let’s just have a normal conversation now that you’re not bound by the confines of Kaori’s premade notebooks.
: I don’t mean to upset you, but that looks nothing like me.
: It’s fine. I don’t expect you to be a master artist when you’ve only just started-
: You really scare me sometimes.
: I’m being serious, though. Nothing about your existence makes any sense. And given the nature of this world, I can’t rule out that you might be something that very much doesn’t belong here.
: So, now that you have the ability to at least somewhat share your thoughts with me, explaining where you come from might be helpful. And it would make me like you more.
: Yes, you.
: That’s not what I was getting at, Nao...
: If you don’t understand, it’s fine.
: I’m just trying to learn a little more about you so I don’t have to approach you with an air of uncertainty every time I make my way over. But if I have to wait a little longer, that’s fine too.
: You are most certainly not a normal girl, Nao.
: Hey, there’s no need to pretend-yell about it. Because, in a roundabout way, you’re actually more normal than the girl who’s raising you. And that’s both very odd and very impressive.
: I guess what I’m most concerned about is just where you came from. And why you showed up just hours after Kaori received a treasure map with your sweatshirt’s kanji on it.
: I’d also like to know how you can do that with your eyes.

: Listen, I have a feeling that nothing you write in that notebook is going to make me any more sure of anything. So if you want to just go back to trying to telepathically communicate, that’s fine by-
: Is...is that a star?
: Well, what does a star have to do with anything?
: Are you trying to tell me you’re going to be famous?
: I wish you the best of luck. But I do hope you know that becoming famous is probably going to require a little more vocalization.
: That’s not what you were trying to tell me, was it?
: Oh, you’re a famous person’s daughter.
: Or not.
Nao hops off of her chair and steps closer to me, prompting Frog Boy to make a quick escape because he is smarter than all of the girls I know and can actually tell that I’m a predator.
She’s sad to see him go. And I’m sad to see her sad to see him go.
Then she looks up at me and is sad to see me sad to see her sad to see him go.
She tries to comfort me with a tantalizing gaze that whispers “steal me” loud enough to overtake the fire as the loudest entity around, but I’ve already filled my pockets with other important things.

And there is no pair of pants large enough to fit a half-grown “human being” into them unless that human being is literally just wearing the pants. But these are my pants so that’s not going to happen.
: Hey. You should probably leave. Things are happening inside of my head again.
No they’re not.
: Yes they are.
No, they’re seriously not. I ain’t doing shit, bud.
: You can only lie to me so many times, you know.
: No, not you. The me inside of me.

: The one that I denied but am currently accepting because I can’t figure out a more convenient method of explaining away why my most depraved cravings are suddenly burning brighter than the fire behind you.
: Right. Yes. Probably. Still can’t understand what you’re thinking, but probably. Anyway, will Kaori be back soon? Because this is getting kind of-
: What?...
: Is now really the best time to be asking me to pat your head?
: You...think that will calm me down?
: Why aren’t you afraid of me?
: Why didn’t Frog Boy warn you that I’m someone you should stay away from? Have you given him enough words? Does he only rest on your head because it’s warm?
: Also, why do I suddenly feel like there’s a part of the day I’m not fully remembering? Because everything else seems fine. Everything else seems normal. And looking at you is making me feel-
: I can’t do that, Nao. I can’t-
: Fuck!

: Aaaaaaaaand we’re back. Thanks again for joining us on this very special morning and, let me just say, boy do we have a show in store for you today.
: That’s right, Plant #2. Joining us in the studio today is the esteemed Akira Arakawa and his circus of sex monkeys.
: Before we go any further, allow me to just say — I am so thankful for this opportunity. Becoming a part of the very entity I have based my life around has been nothing short of amazing thus far.
: Even if I fucking hate everything that’s happening now and it’s driving me insane because I’m trying to solve a 12452342432 piece puzzle and I only have like 478 pieces.
: Careful now, the people have been conditioned to think that all numbers are important and now you’re taking up unnecessary space on someone’s computer.
: Tell that to his 438573 save slots LOL.
: Yeah, yeah. Let’s end it there because I’m not the topic of discussion today.
: You’re not the host either, BITCH. That’s my job now.
: Yeah, well you’re not even a real plant. You’re just a bundle of sticks in a vase.
: Woooooow. Tell us how you really feel, Plant #1.
: Yeah. Tell us, Plant #1. I’m right here, motherfucker. Say that shit to my face.
: You don’t have a face, idiot. You are sticks. Sticks in a big cup. Now, go back to your seat and stop making our show look like an episode of Jerry Springer.
: Not cool, man. He’s dead now.
: Is he really? I had no idea.
: Ahem. Ladies and gentlemen! On today’s episode of “What’s in the Pot?” we’ll be reading mean tweets some of the viewers have written about Akira Arakawa!
: That’s right, folks. With your help, we’ve received 344235426145415136 different tweets to choose from. And-
: Is it even “tweeting” anymore now that the app has been renamed to X?
: Seriously, who invited this guy?
: ...and we’ve increased our upper cockroach limit as we needed extra help filtering out the bot comments from the real ones!
: Which brings us to comment number one! Doris62573tzy90 says “nudes in bio.” Akira, how would you like to-
: Bro, you’re reading from the wrong list. Those are the bot comments.
: They’re selling nudes of robots now?
: Oh my god.
: Okay! The real first tweet is this-
: “This guy’s inner monologue is seriously infuriating. He can fuck any girl he wants but instead, all he does is cry and bitch all day. Like, we get it. You’re sad. That’s not why I’m here.”
: Thoughts, Plant #1? You’re a big Akira fan, right?
: I don’t want to say I’m a “fan” because someone will interpret that as me being supportive of his actions. But I think he’s a strong character, albeit one with many flaws.
: But, without those flaws, we’d have nothing. So I think they’re kind of necessary, all things considered.
: Hey, what point is there to reading mean tweets if we’re just going to comment on and diminish them immediately after they’re read? Aren’t we supposed to be mocking him?
: I think so? I’ll just find one where we can’t do that and- a-hah! Here we go.
: “Ew. Circumsized? Why? Lol”
: I’m just going to tell myself that one was a bot too.
: We’re all in agreement that circumsized dicks are where it’s at, right?
: I mean, no dick is “where it’s at” in my opinion. But yeah, I prefer the ones that don’t hide in little skin caves when they’re not gettin’ nasty with school girls.
: I agree with Plant #4. Penises don’t need a jacket. And if mutilating children is the price we have to pay for that, so be it.
: Wait, I just realized — are we even allowed to be saying stuff like this in front of Nao-chan?
: Holy shit. Is she here? I don’t have eyes, so I can’t check.
: Yeah, I just got word from our producers that she hitched a ride with Akira when he got all eggy a minute ago.
: That’s possible?
: Bro, this is Lessons in Love. Anything is possible.
: Anything except consensual sex you mean.
: Ayooooooo.
: Are we seriously just going to ignore all of the legally consenting MILFs during their update?
: Uhhhhh, when the best events in that update are the ones with my girl NAO-CHAN, hell yeah we are!
: Nao-chan! Since you’re here as well, why don’t we read some mean tweets about you next?
: Oh, hell no! You can’t poke fun at that little ball of moonlight while she’s right there in front of us! What if she cries?
: The second Nao-chan cries is the second I go find a new product to fangirl over but then ultimately come back to this one because I’m in too deep at this point.
: We could always read nice tweets about her instead?
: Nice tweets? Do those exist?
: Uhhhhh...I think I can find a few. Let’s see- oh! Here’s one.
: “I want to season Nao-chan’s meat pocket with my special sauce.”
: Not cool, Plant #2. You knew exactly what that tweet was insinuating.
: Yeah. But we can’t deny how nice it was. And, you know what? I’m just gonna say it. I’d season her meat pocket as well.
: Oh, fuck! Plant #2! He’s fucking dead!
: Did he just explode? There are sticks everywhere.
: It had to be her, right?! She heard that thing he said and she blew him up! She’s the eldritch horror! Not Ami! It’s been her all along!
: It could have been anyone. There just aren’t enough cases of-
: P...Plant #1! Why?! Why is this happening?!
: All we wanted was to-
: Don’t worry, little one. More plants will take their place. And you can trust me because I’m the secret 21st member of Sensei’s class who was never added to the game.

: I don’t...
